question: A municipality is setting up its first multi-year sewer rehabilitation program. What should the program be based on first?
correctAnswer: Condition and risk information gathered across the whole system
explanation: A rehabilitation program is built from system-wide condition and risk information, so spending goes to the sewers that need it most.
options: A fixed rotation that lines the oldest pipe in each ward in turn
Condition and risk information gathered across the whole system
The rehabilitation method the lining contractor prefers to install
Complaints received from residents during the most recent budget year
optionA: A fixed rotation that lines the oldest pipe in each ward in turn
optionB: Condition and risk information gathered across the whole system
optionC: The rehabilitation method the lining contractor prefers to install
optionD: Complaints received from residents during the most recent budget year

question: In a risk-based method for prioritizing sewer projects, which two factors are combined most directly?
correctAnswer: Likelihood of failure and consequence of failure

options: The age of the pipe and the material it was made from
Crew availability during the planned construction season
Likelihood of failure and consequence of failure
Recent rainfall totals and the number of complaints logged
optionA: The age of the pipe and the material it was made from
optionB: Crew availability during the planned construction season
optionC: Likelihood of failure and consequence of failure

question: Which rehabilitation method is trenchless and forms a new pipe inside the existing host pipe?
correctAnswer: Cured in place pipe (CIPP) lining
explanation: CIPP lining installs a resin-impregnated tube inside the host pipe and cures it in place, forming a new pipe within the old one.

Open cut replacement using full excavation along the street
Spot repair of a single joint using an internal patch only
Chemical grouting used to seal one leaking joint at a time
optionA: Cured in place pipe (CIPP) lining
optionB: Open cut replacement using full excavation along the street
optionC: Spot repair of a single joint using an internal patch only
optionD: Chemical grouting used to seal one leaking joint at a time

Move all remaining funds to Basin A because it responded well
